description: A precise question that advances the presence and obtainment of information, framed by one lens of regional industrial reality.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The question, in the owner's words.

fields.name: goal
fields.description: The goal this question was converted from.

fields.name: service
fields.description: The service the goal belongs to.

fields.name: lens
fields.description: Law, land, companies, products, processes or programs.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Region or jurisdiction the question is about.

fields.name: horizon
fields.description: Historic or current information.

fields.name: raised_by
fields.description: Who raised the goal behind it.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Internal service or external app.

fields.name: trust
fields.description: Where the instructions came from. Derived or external never get unguarded write permission.

fields.name: sensitivity
fields.description: What kind of data the work touches.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: Pulled in by a scan or filed in by hand or API.

fields.name: cadence
fields.description: How often the intake repeats.

fields.name: bay
fields.description: The bay accumulating results.

fields.name: store
fields.description: The store the results are finally merged into.

fields.name: reviews
fields.description: How many human review gates apply.

fields.name: checks
fields.description: Names of the acceptance checks that must pass.

fields.name: due
fields.description: Due date, if any.

fields.name: procedure
fields.description: Exact steps to run, in order. When present the handoff is exact and needs no interpretation.

fields.name: writes
fields.description: True if the work changes files; forces a gate for non-owner trust.

fields.name: machine
fields.description: A machine name (letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore) or "any".

fields.name: path
fields.description: Folder the task runs in (for example ~/na/na-research). Emitted so the handoff states where the work happens.

fields.name: status_note
fields.description: Free note for the owner.

fields.name: supersedes
fields.description: An earlier question this one replaces.

steps.text: Intake is by filing: attach or file the source records, then run `assembly dispatch` for this ID.
